title: Self signed certificate
symptom: User wants to use xDrip as an uploader over HTTPS with a self-signed certificate because they host Nightscout themselves without a domain and cannot get a Let's Encrypt certificate for an IP address.
evidence_quote: is it possible to add an Option to use xdrip as an uploader over https (Nightscout/Freestyle Libre 2/Rest API) with a self signed certificate.
